simple.meaning: מַחֲנֵה־דָן (Machănêh-Dân) is a Hebrew word meaning “Machaneh-Dan , a place in Palestine.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מַחֲנֵה־דָן (H4265) before moving outward to related references.
